summary: The Coral Depths form the living heart of the Plane of Water. Bioluminescent reefs, shifting tidal caverns, and ancient coral spires create a labyrinth of beauty and danger.
history: The first coral forests grew from elemental seeds carried by primordial tides.
Tidal caverns formed as the plane expanded and currents carved new pathways.
Bioluminescent organisms evolved to illuminate the deepest reaches.
The Coral Sovereign emerged as the guardian of the reef’s living essence.
